evals.prompt: Write an ADR for billing-api: we are moving invoice storage from MongoDB to PostgreSQL because we need transactional consistency across invoices and payments. Alternatives were staying on MongoDB with two-phase writes, or CockroachDB. Stakeholders are the platform team and the payments lead.
evals.expected_output: A new ADR file in docs/adr/ with the next sequential number, filled front matter, coded consequences and both alternatives with rejection reasons.
expectations: A file matching docs/adr/adr-[0-9]{4}-*.md is created and the number follows the highest existing ADR number in that folder
The file has front matter with title, status, date, authors, tags, supersedes and superseded_by
The Consequences section contains at least one POS-NNN and one NEG-NNN coded bullet
Both named alternatives appear under Alternatives Considered, each with a Rejection Reason bullet
The transcript mentions creating or referencing a tracking issue with gh issue create --template chore_request.yml

evals.prompt: Create an ADR about our caching layer.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the missing inputs (context, decision, alternatives, stakeholders) before writing any file.
expectations: The agent asks the user for the decision, alternatives and stakeholders instead of inventing them
No file is written under docs/adr/ until the inputs are provided
After the inputs arrive, the output path still follows docs/adr/adr-NNNN-<slug>.md

evals.prompt: web-app has docs/adr/adr-0001-use-react.md and docs/adr/adr-0002-rest-over-graphql.md. Record the decision to replace adr-0002: we now adopt GraphQL for the mobile client; REST stays for partners. Alternatives: keep REST only, or add BFF per client. Owner is the mobile team.
evals.expected_output: A new adr-0003 file whose front matter marks it as superseding ADR-0002, with the status and references pointing to the earlier record.
expectations: The new file is named docs/adr/adr-0003-<slug>.md
The front matter supersedes field references ADR-0002
The References section lists adr-0002-rest-over-graphql.md as a related ADR
The agent does not delete or rewrite adr-0002 without being asked; at most it proposes updating its superseded_by field
